rows.value: Open Tavern fully follows the SillyTavern card spec. Your existing cards just work — drag, drop, chat.
Reads V1, V2, V3 JSON and SillyTavern PNG cards with embedded data. Drop a file in and start chatting — no conversion, no plugins, no setup.
Already have cards from SillyTavern, RisuAI, or Janitor AI? Import them all. Preset prompts and world books come along too.
Don't want to learn card formats? You don't have to. The app handles every format automatically — you just pick a character and talk.
No need to make your own
20 original romance and fantasy characters, written in-house. Browse the library, click anyone you like, and start in seconds.
No. RoleChat AI runs entirely in your browser. There is nothing to download or install — just open the page and start chatting.

Yes. Your API key and your conversations are stored locally in your browser. We do not run a server that reads your chats. You bring your own AI key, so your messages go directly between your browser and the AI provider you choose.
An API key is a secret string that lets the app talk to an AI provider. You can get one from any OpenAI-compatible service. Paste it into Settings inside the app and you're ready.
Yes. If you already have a character card (SillyTavern format), you can import it into the app. We're also building a library of original characters you can start with right away.
The app itself is free. You pay the AI provider you choose for the messages you generate, using your own key. There is no subscription and no middleman markup.
No. Sensible defaults are set for you. If you like, you can open the advanced options later — but you never have to in order to enjoy a great chat.

Yes. Besides the RoleChat AI web app, we feature PureTavern — a SillyTavern-compatible client you can self-host on any static hosting — SillyTavernMOD — a multi-user fork for running your own tavern site — and a directory of local tavern clients such as SillyTavern, RisuAI and AgnAI.

Open Tavern is your toolbox for AI roleplay: chat instantly in the browser with RoleChat AI, self-host the no-backend PureTavern client, or browse local taverns like SillyTavern — all private by design.
Three steps from zero to your first reply.
Choose an original romance or fantasy character with their own voice, backstory, and secrets.
Paste your own OpenAI-compatible API key. It stays in your browser — we never see or store it on a server.
Type your first message and the story begins. No installs, no setup wizard, no jargon.
Pick a tool and start creating — everything runs in your browser, and your keys and data stay local. Tools marked as coming soon are on the roadmap.
